messages:
nisha: Following up from the postmortem — summary and concrete remediation plan for cloud-rate-limit + model-registry auth cascade. Keeping this thread for brief acknowledgements; full updates go in infra-incidents.

omar: please paste action owners + due dates so we can instrument dashboards.

nisha: Actions (owner -> due):
- gateway backoff + token-stampede protection (omar) -> 2026-04-07
- registry read-replica + manifest checksum cache (felix) -> 2026-04-03
- emergency routing: circuit-breaker -> dedicated pools + region-failover (chandra) -> 2026-04-12
- vendor-contact runbook & SLA escalation template (nisha) -> 2026-03-31
- recurring-incident detector (query + weekly digest) (nisha) -> 2026-04-02

felix: For manifest cache plan: short TTL (15s-45s), checksum diff to avoid full fetches. I'll list affected services and compatibility shim in the PR.

omar: On gateway: adding exponential backoff + jitter, plus in-memory token cache so we don't hit vendor during bulk refresh. Will also add metrics: token_refresh_failures and token_cache_hit_rate.

chandra: Circuit-breaker will be thresholded on 5xx% and token-failure-rate. Routing fallback to dedicated pool has a cooldown. Will include automated rollback in the playbook.

oncall-bot: Reminder: create infra-incidents issue using template vendor-deps/remediation and tag with owners.

nisha: I'll create the issue and set up a tracking board column for 'vendor mitigations'. Also propose a 30/90 day recurrence check that auto-notifies owners when patterns appear.

omar: Staging test plan: 1) simulate provider 429s via sim tool; 2) ensure gateway backoff prevents >70% token refresh error spikes; 3) measure end-to-end p95 increase. Script: ```python tools/simulate_vendor_errors.py --target auth --mode 429 --duration 300```

felix: I'll run registry replica tests with synthetic traffic and validate failover time <15s.

nisha: Checkpoint: 2026-03-29 11:00 PT to review PRs and staging results. If you can't meet the due date, update the infra-incidents issue and ping me.

chandra: Adding playbook snippets to PR including smoke tests and a manual rollback section.

oncall-bot: Action required: assign owners on infra-incidents and set due_date fields.

omar: Quick note: prefer gateway cache over SDK changes for speed of rollout. We'll document SDK path later.

nisha: Thanks — I'll send invite for the checkpoint and add the weekly recurrence digest to the infra-incidents automation. Keep all follow-ups in that issue (not this thread).
